---
title: "Environment Summary"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Env")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
env <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber = ?",
  list(params$plot_number)
)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

if (nrow(env) > 0) {
  desired <- c("plotnumber", "projectid", "date", "sitesurveyor", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation",
               "aspect", "slopegradient", "mesoslopeposition", "surfaceshape", "moistureregime",
               "nutrientregime", "sitenotes")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(env))
  env <- env[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}
```

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r env-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(env) > 0) {
  kbl(env, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No environment data found.")
}
```
